description: The ledger accepts a fractional amount_minor, silently rounds 1.5 to 2 in numeric(16,0), and then rejects an identical retry as revision_key_conflict; this violates integer typed validation and exact-retry idempotency.

evidence.snippet: amount_minor numeric(16, 0), ... CHECK (amount_minor IS NULL OR (amount_minor >= 0 AND amount_minor <= 9007199254740991))
evidence.testName: real PostgreSQL fractional minor-unit probe: stored_amount=2; identical retry rejected with SQLSTATE 23505 revision_key_conflict
